name: Cardiac Arrest
summary:
Cardiac Arrest is an interactive virtual reality training simulation designed to help learners develop the knowledge and confidence needed to respond effectively during a cardiac arrest emergency.
Step into realistic emergency scenarios where you will assess the patient, recognize the signs of cardiac arrest, activate the emergency response process, perform high-quality CPR, and correctly use an Automated External Defibrillator (AED).
